The '''Cascardi Mountains''' were a [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duneeden]]. [[Didi Oddo]], a business owner, held a private retreat in this mountain range. After the events of Stadum 5 where Didi Oddo fled from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], he retreated to his home on the Cascardi Mountains. He was not the only person with resorts in the Cascardi Mountains, but not many people traveled to the planet so it was a nice place to live.<ref name="JA" />
